drug_class: Combination Topical Antibiotic and Keratolytic Agent
purpose: This medication is used to treat acne on your skin. It helps clear up pimples, reduces redness, and prevents new breakouts from forming. It works best for moderate acne that has not improved with other treatments.
how_it_works: This gel combines two acne-fighting ingredients that work together. Clindamycin is an antibiotic that kills the bacteria on your skin that cause acne. Benzoyl peroxide helps unclog your pores and also prevents bacteria from becoming resistant to the antibiotic, making the combination more effective than either ingredient alone.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects are dryness, peeling, redness, and mild irritation at the spot where you apply it. Your skin may feel itchy or look slightly red, especially when you first start using it. These effects are usually mild and often improve after your skin gets used to the medication.
warnings: Benzoyl peroxide can bleach hair, clothing, towels, and bed sheets, so be careful and let it dry completely before contact with fabrics. Avoid getting this medication in your eyes, mouth, or inside your nose. Tell your doctor if you have a history of bowel problems, as clindamycin in rare cases can cause serious intestinal issues. Do not use this on large areas of broken or irritated skin without talking to your doctor first.
typical_dosing: Apply a thin layer to the affected area of your face once a day, usually in the morning after washing your face. Use only a small pea-sized amount and spread it gently over the acne-prone areas. Always follow the directions your doctor or pharmacist gave you, as dosing can vary slightly depending on which brand you are using.
